Coffee Origination and Procurement Specialist About Torq Commodities Torq Commodities is an international commodities trading company connecting sourcing markets with customers across global markets. With operations spanning multiple countries, Torq focuses on building reliable supply relationships and delivering commercially competitive solutions through its sourcing, trading and logistics capabilities. As part of its expansion in Vietnam, Torq is strengthening its direct coffee sourcing capabilities to support customers in the UK, Europe, the US and other international markets. Role Purpose Torq Commodities is seeking an experienced, commercially driven Coffee Origination & Procurement Specialist to establish and strengthen its direct coffee sourcing capabilities in Vietnam. The role will focus on developing relationships with producers, plantations, cooperatives, processors and exporters to secure competitively priced, quality coffee for export to the UK, Europe, the US and other international markets where Torq has established sales capabilities. The successful candidate will deliver a measurable sourcing advantage through direct market access, competitive negotiations and reliable supply arrangements. Key Responsibilities Coffee Origination and Supplier Development Identify and develop direct sourcing opportunities across Vietnam’s coffee-producing regions. Build and maintain strong relationships with coffee producers, plantations, cooperatives, processors and exporters. Assess suppliers’ production capacity, quality capabilities, financial reliability and ability to fulfil supply commitments. Develop a diversified supplier network to support consistent availability and reduce dependence on individual suppliers or intermediaries Commercial Procurement and Negotiation Lead procurement negotiations covering price, quality specifications, volumes, delivery schedules, payment terms and contractual conditions. Secure competitive sourcing terms that create a demonstrable advantage against comparable offers from international brokers and traders. Evaluate total procurement costs, including processing, inland transportation, storage and export-related expenses. Structure purchases within approved commercial terms, budgets and risk limits. Identify opportunities to improve trading margins through supplier selection, sourcing timing and procurement strategy. Market Intelligence and Sourcing Strategy Monitor local coffee prices, crop developments, availability, supplier activity and market conditions. Provide timely market intelligence and sourcing recommendations to Torq’s international trading teams. Develop sourcing plans aligned with customer requirements, sales commitments and anticipated demand. Identify supply risks and recommend practical alternatives to protect continuity. Quality and Supply Assurance Work with suppliers and quality teams to ensure coffee meets agreed specifications and customer requirements. Coordinate sampling, quality evaluation, inspections and resolution of quality discrepancies. Establish appropriate supplier traceability and maintain accurate sourcing records. Monitor supplier performance and address quality issues, delivery delays and volume shortfalls. Export and Internal Coordination Coordinate with trading, logistics, finance and documentation teams to support timely execution of procurement contracts and export shipments. Ensure supplier documentation and sourcing practices meet applicable requirements for the relevant destination market. Align sourcing commitments with sales requirements and shipment schedules. Maintain clear records of negotiations, contracts, procurement costs and supplier performance. Required Experience and Capabilities Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in coffee origination and procurement, with substantial hands-on sourcing experience in Vietnam. An established network of relationships with leading coffee producers, plantations, cooperatives, processors and exporters across Vietnam. Demonstrated ability to originate supply directly and secure meaningful commercial volumes. Proven success in negotiating competitive procurement terms and delivering measurable sourcing or margin improvements. Strong understanding of coffee quality, grading, processing, crop cycles, pricing and export procurement. Experience supporting international coffee trading or supplying export-oriented businesses. Sound commercial judgment and the ability to assess supplier, quality and delivery risks. Strong negotiation, relationship management and analytical skills. Vietnamese proficiency and working English sufficient for coordination with international teams. Willingness to travel regularly within Vietnam. Preferred Qualifications MBA in Agriculture, Business, International Trade, Supply Chain or a related discipline. Experience working with both Robusta and Arabica coffee. Familiarity with customer-specific sustainability, certification and traceability requirements. Relevant coffee quality evaluation or industry certifications would be an advantage. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be assessed against mutually agreed targets covering: Sourcing advantage:  Procurement cost improvements against comparable market offers, assessed on equivalent quality, delivery and payment terms. Direct supplier development:  Number and commercial contribution of qualified, active origin suppliers. Procurement volumes:  Ability to secure agreed volumes aligned with trading requirements. Quality and delivery:  Compliance with specifications and timely fulfilment of supply commitments. Commercial contribution:  Contribution to trading margins and effective management of procurement costs. Supply reliability:  Supplier performance, sourcing diversification and continuity of supply.

review_candidates.description: We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Customs Clearance team as a Clearance Administrator. Who We Are FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers.
